title: Gauge-Equivariant Dual-Boundary Energy Profile Head

inputs.source: frozen full D2 bidirectional multi-radius trajectory energy profiles
forbidden: sealed endpoint labels as model input

model.prediction: two non-negative distances from observations 0 and 1
model.weight_sharing: one shared side encoder and positive distance head
model.swap_action: swap/reverse sides; output distances swap exactly
model.profile_order: scalar order is preserved and supplied explicitly

training.loss: object-macro symmetric log-distance regression plus exact swap consistency audit
training.split: object-disjoint train/calibration/dev supplied by node7.1 materialization
training.selection: single preregistered configuration; no seed/checkpoint/result selection

conformal.score: max absolute normalized endpoint-distance residual per object

primary_gates: object-macro endpoint NMAE improves over frozen full D2
object-macro endpoint NMAE improves over global prior
object-macro endpoint NMAE improves over range prior
paired interval is narrower than marginal and global conformal at matched coverage

nulls.zero_geometry: replace all energy channels by zero while retaining scalar coordinates
nulls.profile_permutation: permute profile samples but retain the original scalar coordinates at their positions
nulls.order_only: retain scalar/order coordinates and remove all geometry-derived energy channels

stopping: implementation, CPU tests, and profile-export preflight only until node7.1 materialization exists
